comparison_questions: How thin can the first overlay be while still preserving issue, run, result, and governance traces?
Which Paperclip surfaces map cleanly into VectorFL line, trace, residue, and advisory-return grammar?
What should remain external ontology and what should be translated into VectorFL internal grammar?
acceptance_signals: one issue can become a work-root line candidate
one heartbeat run can become an append-only execution trace
one result comment can become a residue or observation candidate
one governance event can become a hold or caution trace
rejection_signals: the comparison drifts into UI imitation
company / org ontology replaces line-centered grammar
the target becomes broader than issue/run/result/governance
